refnamediv.refpurpose: Generate the filter coefficients of a Hamming window.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: c = hamming(m) c = hamming(m, "periodic") c = hamming(m, "symmetric")

listitem.para: the length of the Hamming window. Must be a positive integer.
(optional) specifies the type of the window. Can be "periodic" or "symmetric".

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Return the filter coefficients of a Hamming window of length m.

If the optional argument "periodic" is given, the periodic form of the window is returned. This is equivalent to the window of length m+1 with the last coefficient removed. The optional argument "symmetric" is equivalent to not specifying a second argument.
For a definition of the Hamming window, see, e.g., A.V. Oppenheim & R. W. Schafer, Discrete-Time Signal Processing.

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: c = hamming(10) c = hamming(10, "periodic") c = hamming(10, "symmetric")

refsection.title: Bibliography
refsection.para: A.V. Oppenheim & R. W. Schafer, Discrete-Time Signal Processing
